seed_meaning: Different training-data shuffles and generation RNG; one common frozen initial adapter, not independent adapter initializations.
budget_scope: Common upper training-time allowance on one local GPU; not identical FLOPs or identical consumed time.
budget_charge: Contiguous committed-batch elapsed time: snapshots, data selection, generation, reward, old-student/teacher scoring, signals, backward/update, evidence, native checkpoint and checksums.
separate_costs: Initial/restart loading and audits; final verification/export; completion-marker/rename/pointer/pruning/log tails; evaluation. Record actual whole-job costs separately.
unclean_interruption: Unknown uncommitted work makes a resumed budgeted run ineligible for formal comparison; clean boundary pause/resume preserves eligibility.
switch_rule: Sequential methods switch before the next batch after the first committed boundary at or above half the common allowance. Preserve Adam moments, constant LR, model and data cursor; report actual phase shares.
data_order: Per-seed deterministic full-pool shuffle; consume fresh on-policy question batches; reshuffle on exhaustion.

evaluation.before_training: Initial student and teacher on all512frozen dev rows
evaluation.intermediate: Same first64dev questions at the half-budget checkpoint, outside training clock
evaluation.endpoint: All512dev questions at the predetermined eligible final checkpoint
evaluation.official_test: All1319test questions for each15finaladapter and initialstudent after protocol frozen; no test access during this preparation stage
evaluation.selection: No best-checkpoint selection or method-specific tuning from endpoint scores
evaluation.decode: Greedy, non-thinking, cap1024newtokens, batch4, frozen rewardv3

research_claim: Best among five declared configurations on this student/teacher/task under a common local training-time allowance; no universal or hyperparameter-optimized winner claim.
